title: Product Returns and the Value of Search Prominence
abstract: arXiv:2410.06791v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ordered-search models typically make prominence valuable because the first-listed seller receives more traffic. We show that product returns can overturn this logic by changing not only the volume but also the composition of demand. We develop a duopoly model in which consumers inspect products sequentially, learn a coarse match signal through search, discover realized taste only after purchase, and may return the product. With positive consumer hassle costs for product returns and a general taste distribution, optimal consumer behavior is characterized by pre-search inspection, post-search purchase, and retention cutoffs. In a low-hassle, full-refund benchmark with uniformly distributed taste values, the non-prominent firm charges a higher price because consumers who reach it are screened by their experience with the prominent product. translated_title: 商品退货与搜索显著性的价值
translated_abstract: 有序搜索模型通常认为显著性（prominence）是有价值的，因为排在首位的卖家会获得更多流量。我们证明，商品退货可以颠覆这一逻辑，因为它不仅改变需求的数量，还会改变需求的构成。我们构建了一个双寡头模型：消费者依次考察产品，通过搜索获得一个粗略的匹配信号，只有在购买之后才了解真实偏好，并可能退回商品。在退货存在正的消费者麻烦成本且偏好分布为一般分布的条件下，最优消费者行为可由搜索前考察、搜索后购买和保留三个临界值刻画。在一个低麻烦成本、全额退款且偏好值服从均匀分布的基准情形中，非显著（非首位）的企业会收取更高价格，因为到达该企业的消费者已经通过与首位产品的互动经历而被筛选。尽管显著性带来更多访问量和总订单，但它也使首位卖家暴露于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 商品退货通过改变需求的数量与构成颠覆了“搜索显著性总是有利”的传统结论——在低退货摩擦、全额退款的情况下，首位卖家因面临被筛选后的逆向选择风险而定价更低，非显著卖家反而可以收取更高价格。
en_tdlr: Product returns can overturn the conventional value of search prominence: by changing both the volume and composition of demand, they force the prominent first-listed seller to charge a lower price, while the non-prominent firm benefits from consumers screened by their experience with the prominent product.
